The hedge fund held 16,924 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.92M, down from 19,664 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Miller Investment Management Lp who had been investing in United Rentals Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $13.32B market cap company.
